issue.title: Replace heavy weight build-tools integ tests with a simple unit test.

repository.name: elasticsearch
repository.description: Free and Open Source, Distributed, RESTful Search Engine

issue.body:
Remove heavy build-tool integ test. 
Add a  unit test for the plugin builder plugin.

Closes #41256 #41256

body: This is effectively a blocker for 8.0 release, yes? Do we have some way of tracking this to ensure this absolutely gets fixed, even though we know that release is still a ways out?
It's also a blocker for `7.x` as we would like to back-port the changes there, so it too will break as soon as we back-port #47022
